claims.claim_text: North Star generally opposes interventions in the national sovereignty and self-determination of nations vulnerable to more powerful neighbors.
North Star particularly urges the U.S. government to prioritize diplomacy.
North Star urges the U.S. government to decline to deploy its own military force except in the most extreme circumstances.
North Star favors a drastic contraction of U.S. defense spending.
North Star favors negotiations aimed at destroying the world’s stock of weapons of mass destruction.
